channel.title: Vifug blog
channel.description: Practical articles on presentation software for churches and live events.

item.title: Different pictures for the room and the online audience
item.description: Why the room needs full-screen words while online viewers need a lower third over the camera, and how to send each audience its own picture.

item.title: Stage display and multiple screens for church services
item.description: Plan confidence monitors, lobby and overflow screens that each show different content, and set them up with Vifug's stage display and per-screen themes.

item.title: Livestream lyrics with OBS, vMix and NDI
item.description: How a transparent lyrics overlay reaches OBS, vMix or an NDI receiver, what each path needs, and how to set it up with Vifug without a capture card.

item.title: Setting up a projector and second screen for church
item.description: How to cable a projector, choose mirror or extend, match resolution and aspect ratio, test brightness, and assign the output screen in Vifug.

item.title: Designing lyric slides people can read from the back row
item.description: Font, size, contrast, outlines, safe margins and reading distance for lyric slides, with the exact settings to use in Vifug's theme designer.

item.title: What is presentation software? Types, uses and how they differ
item.description: A plain explanation of presentation software: slide tools, worship and live-production tools, and signage, and what each kind is actually good at.
